response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced and capable software engineer with 19 years of development background and demonstrated leadership abilities. However, the role requires senior-level C++ expertise for embedded, high-performance industrial systems—his last C++ work was 11 years ago at National Instruments, and his career trajectory has been primarily web, cloud, and full-stack development. More critically, the role emphasizes industrial cybersecurity, SDL implementation, and IEC 62443 compliance as core responsibilities; the candidate shows no evidence of experience in these specialized areas. While his software engineering fundamentals are strong, the specialized technical requirements of this mid-senior C++ role are not met.
strengths: 19 years of diverse software engineering experience exceeding the 8-12 year requirement, with demonstrated maturity in design patterns, testing, and software craftsmanship
Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities evidenced by workshop creation, team collaboration at staff-level positions, and open-source community contributions
Full-stack development expertise with Node.js, TypeScript, and familiarity with cloud platforms, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems design
concerns: C++ expertise is minimal and severely outdated (2014-2015 at National Instruments); primary languages are TypeScript, DLang, and JavaScript, making re-skilling in modern C++ necessary
Zero demonstrated experience with industrial cybersecurity, Secure Development Lifecycle (SDL), IEC 62443 standards, or embedded systems security—all core to this role
Career is rooted in web/cloud/full-stack development rather than industrial automation, embedded systems, or IoT; lacks domain relevance and protocol experience (Modbus, IEC 61850, OPC UA)
